styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.GOBDAN: a plain woman in her late thirties, hair in a low bun with no ornament and no jewelry, coarse undyed hemp jeogori and a worn gray skirt, never silk
characters.YEONI: a girl of about twelve with a long braid, white hemp mourning clothes, clearly a child
characters.ELDEST: a man in his forties with a thin face, white hemp mourning robe and a rough mourning hat
characters.PARK: a very old man in his seventies with a long white beard, thin face, white jeogori

scenes.S01: A Joseon funeral procession stopped on a village road: a large decorated wooden bier with a curved roof carried on long poles by eight men in white hemp clothes, white-clad mourners standing behind it, all facing forward. Plain sky, no letters, no calligraphy, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene on a village road, one clear main figure: a woman in white hemp mourning clothes standing in front of a funeral bier, her crying stopped, her chin lifted and her face calm and firm. Behind her the bier carriers and white-clad mourners turn to look at her in confusion. Daylight.
scenes.S05: GOBDAN kneeling on a straw mat in a mourning house courtyard, crying out loud with her face lifted, her hair in a bare low bun with nothing in it. White clad mourners stand around watching her. Daylight.
scenes.S06: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN walking a hill path with a small bundle in one hand, a thatched village below in the distance. Daylight, no other people.
scenes.S07: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN sitting alone on the bare ground at the far corner of a mourning house yard, eating from a wooden bowl, a stone wall beside her. Lanterns far away. No other people.
scenes.S08: Exactly two people at a wooden veranda: a servant woman standing on the veranda in white socks with no shoes, her shoes left on the stone step below, having just tossed coins down; and GOBDAN crouching on the bare ground below, picking the scattered coins up. Coins lie on the ground. Daylight.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a field path, a funeral bier and a line of mourners walking as black silhouettes, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind them.
scenes.S10: Only one person in the picture: a young woman sitting alone on bare ground under a leafless tree in an open winter field at dusk, knees drawn up, head down. Open sky and distant hills only. There is no wall, no building, no signboard and no paper anywhere, so nothing is written.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN sitting on a low wall at dusk with her bundle beside her, looking far away with a tired face. Village roofs behind. No other people.
scenes.S12: A large Joseon tile-roofed house with a tall gate and a long stone wall, an old persimmon tree behind the back wall, autumn daylight. No people in the foreground.
scenes.S13: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN standing outside a tall stone wall at dawn holding an empty water jar, a closed gate beside her, dark blue morning sky. No other people.
scenes.S14: Only one person in the picture: PARK lying flat on his back with his eyes closed, his head on a small pillow, a quilt up to his chest, on the floor of a dim room, one oil lamp on the floor. He is bare headed, no hat. Nobody else. Plain walls, nothing written.
scenes.S15: Exactly two people and nobody else in a dim Korean room at dawn: PARK lying flat on his back under a quilt, bare headed, one hand lifted gripping the wrist of GOBDAN, who kneels beside him leaning close. One oil lamp. Plain walls, nothing written.
scenes.S16: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN stepping out into a dark courtyard at dawn with her hand still over her mouth, the house dark behind her. No other people.
scenes.S17: A mourning house courtyard full of people in white hemp mourning clothes kneeling and wailing, lanterns lit, white paper strips hanging. Morning light, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S19: Only one person in the picture: ELDEST, a man in his forties in white hemp mourning robe and a mourning hat, kneeling and wailing with his mouth wide open but dry eyes, a straw mat under him. No other people.
scenes.S20: Only one person in the picture: YEONI, a small girl of about twelve with a short child body and a long braid, sitting alone in a courtyard corner hugging her knees, white mourning clothes, tears on her face. She is a little child, not a grown woman. Plain wall, nothing written.
scenes.S21: Exactly three people on a wooden veranda: ELDEST in mourning clothes speaking with his hands together, and two village elders with gray beards and black gat hats listening with folded arms. Daylight.
scenes.S22: Only one person in the picture: YEONI, a small girl of about twelve with a short child body, standing alone in a courtyard holding a small cloth bundle with both arms, head down. She is a little child, not a grown woman. Plain wall, no letters, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S23: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN stepping forward into the middle of a courtyard with her back straight and her chin up, dust on her hemp skirt, speaking. No other people.
scenes.S24: Exactly three people: ELDEST in mourning clothes waving one hand dismissively with a cold face, and two village elders laughing quietly behind him, in a courtyard. Daylight.
scenes.S26: GOBDAN standing in an open courtyard speaking to a group of village men and women who gather around her, some carrying hoes. Daylight, a tile-roofed house behind.
scenes.S27: [WEB] Scene in the back yard of a large Korean house under an old persimmon tree: THREE village men digging into the ground with hoes, the round shoulder of a buried clay jar appearing in the dirt, a crowd of villagers leaning in to look, a girl of about twelve standing at the right. Daylight.
scenes.S28: Only one person in the picture: an old village elder with a gray beard kneeling on the ground beside an opened clay jar, lifting out a rolled blank paper with both hands, a silver hairpin and a small wooden box on a cloth beside the jar. Nobody else. The paper is blank, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S29: Exactly three people standing in a courtyard: two village elders with gray beards holding an open paper scroll between them and reading with serious faces, ELDEST standing behind them going pale. The paper is blank, no letters anywhere. Daylight.
scenes.S30: Only one person in the picture: ELDEST standing stiffly in a courtyard with a pale face and one hand at his collar, mourning hat slightly askew. No other people.
scenes.S32: Exactly two people in a courtyard: GOBDAN bending down and holding both hands of YEONI, a girl of about twelve in white mourning clothes, who looks up at her with wet eyes. Daylight. No other people.
scenes.S33: Exactly two people on a veranda: a village elder holding out a cloth pouch with both hands, and GOBDAN stepping back with both palms raised, shaking her head. Daylight.
scenes.S34: GOBDAN kneeling on a straw mat in a mourning house courtyard crying out loud, white-clad mourners standing behind her with bowed heads. Daylight.
scenes.S35: Only one person in the picture: GOBDAN sitting alone on the floor of a small dim room at night, her face in both hands, shoulders shaking, one oil lamp beside her. No other people.
scenes.S36: [SIL] Sunset over a hill path, a lone woman with a small bundle walking as a black silhouette, layered gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold behind her.
scenes.S37: GOBDAN kneeling and crying in the small yard of a poor thatched house, two or three villagers standing quietly behind her, a plain straw mat on the ground. Daylight.
scenes.S38: Exactly two people at the gate of a small thatched house: a young woman in her twenties in a neat jeogori holding a wrapped gift with both hands, and GOBDAN, now older, standing in the doorway with a surprised face. Daylight.
scenes.S39: [SIL] Full moon over a quiet thatched village at night, low roofs and a hill as black silhouettes, layered silver clouds and a band of gold light.
